results.occurrenceRemarks: Photographs provided by Philippa Berry Smith (1-3) and Duncan Milne (4). Pod of orca first reported by Duncan Milne on the Project Hotspot facebook page and Thomas McElroy by text out from the wind wand at approximately 11am. Philippa Berry Smith emailed photos. After leaving the port the orca headed past Kaweroa Reef, East End and Fitzroy Beach. Also reported in stuff: http://www.stuff.co.nz/taranaki-daily-news/news/85885228/orcas-give-new-plymouth-surfers-and-walkers-a-sunday-thrill
